# Getting Support

Pick the route that matches what you need.

## Questions and setup help

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/agigante80/actual-mcp-server/issues/new?template=question.yml). Before you do, check the [docs](../docs/README.md) and the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Bugs and feature requests

Use the [issue templates](https://github.com/agigante80/actual-mcp-server/issues/new/choose): the bug report for something broken, the feature request for something new.

## Security vulnerabilities

Never open a public issue. Use the [private advisory form](https://github.com/agigante80/actual-mcp-server/security/advisories/new). The full policy is in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What to include

The server version, the transport (HTTP or stdio), the AI client you use, what you expected, and the relevant log lines with passwords, tokens and budget data removed.

## Conduct

Everyone taking part follows the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
